description: Builds a structured reply to a message: greeting to the sender (name detected from the sign-off, or sender_name), acknowledgement, every question and request found in the message listed with an answer placeholder, deadlines noted, and a tone-matched sign-off. Deterministic template: it organizes the reply but does not invent the answers (placeholders in [brackets]). Input up to 20000 characters. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

sender_name.description: Name to greet (otherwise detected from the sign-off).

text.description: The message you are replying to.

tone.description: clear (default), concise, warm, friendly, or formal.

your_name.description: Name to sign with (otherwise a [Your name] placeholder).

name: reply.draft
title: Reply draft skeleton
